intro.text: Dalinar Kholin's infantrylord on the Shattered Plains, in command of his foot soldiers.

items.text: As one of Dalinar's highmarshals, Perethom had his men prepare oil and torches for a night assault on Rathalas, then led a bloody fight to take a section of the city wall before Sadeas and Teleb arrived to rout the last defenders. Dalinar then ordered the city burned.

On the Shattered Plains he commanded Dalinar's infantry on the Shattered Plains. When a chasmfiend was spotted and the army prepared for a plateau run, he reported that his second and third battalions were on duty.
Perethom died with Havar, Ilamar and thousands of other Kholin soldiers at the Tower, after Sadeas betrayed Dalinar.
